rules.false_positive_analysis: Advisory: direct runtime React import and inline async function only. Inner async work, synchronous setup, custom hooks, type-only imports, binding escapes and shadows stay silent. TypeScript or lint may already reject this code.

sources.claim: Effect setup may return cleanup or nothing; an async function returns a Promise. Missing dependencies alone do not establish an infinite loop.
Taxonomy for the local API/configuration boundary, not execution or exploitability evidence.

positive.source:
import {useEffect} from 'react';
export function useRefresh() { useEffect(async () => { await refresh(); }, []); }

import {useLayoutEffect} from 'react';
export function useRefresh() { useLayoutEffect(async () => { await refresh(); }, []); }

import {useInsertionEffect} from 'react';
export function useRefresh() { useInsertionEffect(async () => { await refresh(); }, []); }

import {useEffect as setup} from 'react';
export function useRefresh() { setup(async () => { await refresh(); }, []); }

import {useEffect} from 'react';
export function useRefresh() { useEffect(async function setup() { await refresh(); }, []); }

import * as React from 'react';
export function useRefresh() { React.useEffect(async () => { await refresh(); }, []); }

negative.source:
import {useEffect} from 'react';
export function useRefresh() { useEffect(() => { void refresh(); }, []); }

import {useEffect} from 'react';
export function useRefresh() { useEffect(() => { async function run() { await refresh(); } void run(); return cancel; }, []); }

import {useEffect} from 'react';
export function useRefresh() { useEffect(() => { auditCommit(); } ); }

import {useEffect} from './custom-hooks';
export function useRefresh() { useEffect(async () => { await refresh(); }, []); }

import type {useEffect} from 'react';
export function useRefresh() { useEffect(async () => { await refresh(); }, []); }

import {type useEffect} from 'react';
export function useRefresh() { useEffect(async () => { await refresh(); }, []); }

import {useEffect} from 'react';
export function useRefresh() { useEffect(synchronousSetup, []); }

import {useEffect} from 'react';
export function useRefresh() { useEffect(async function* setup() { yield 1; }, []); }

adversarial.rationale: A comment cannot invoke React or register asynchronous effect setup.

adversarial.source:
import {useEffect} from 'react';
export function useRefresh(useEffect: any) { useEffect(async () => { await refresh(); }, []); }
adversarial.rationale: A typed parameter shadows the imported hook.
A changed hook binding does not establish React identity.

adversarial.source:
import {useEffect} from 'react';
export function useRefresh() { useEffect(async () => { /* returning cleanup asynchronously is still wrong */ return cancel; }, []); }
adversarial.rationale: Returning cleanup through a Promise is still not synchronous effect cleanup.

rules.false_positive_analysis: Advisory: direct await of an imported callback pipeline with an inline function callback. Promises imports, callback-only calls, wrappers, type imports, shadows, spread arguments and chained results stay unresolved or silent.

sources.claim: Callback pipeline returns the destination; the stream/promises API supplies completion promises.
Taxonomy for the local API/configuration boundary, not execution or exploitability evidence.

async function transfer(source, destination) { await pipeline(source, destination, (error) => { report(error); }); }

async function transfer(source, destination) { await pipeline(source, destination, function done(error) { report(error); }); }

async function transfer(source, destination) { await streams.pipeline(source, destination, (error) => { report(error); }); }

Dynamic URLs, duplicate URL keys, custom Client/connection/stream options, spreads and unresolved bindings stay silent. Intentional precedence may be acceptable.

rules.false_positive_analysis: Advisory: one SQL file with supported explicit BEGIN or START TRANSACTION and concurrent index creation before completion. Comments, strings, dollar bodies, committed transactions and non-concurrent indexes stay silent. Procedural unquoted bodies and psql metacommands need a grammar-aware route.

sources.claim: PostgreSQL CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY cannot run inside a transaction block.
Taxonomy for the local API/configuration boundary, not execution or exploitability evidence.

negative.source:
CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY account_lookup ON accounts (id);
COMMIT;

DO $body$ BEGIN CREATE INDEX account_lookup ON accounts(id); END; $body$;
CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY account_lookup ON accounts(id);

adversarial.rationale: Commented transaction text has no DDL effect.
A dollar-quoted body does not begin a top-level transaction.
Nested PostgreSQL comments keep transaction-looking text outside executable SQL.
Whitespace and comments preserve concurrent DDL.

rules.false_positive_analysis: Advisory: single SQL-language SELECT body, explicit pg_temp-first path and bare FROM relation only. Invoker functions, qualified relations, temp-last or empty paths, procedural bodies, CTEs, dynamic settings, escaped bodies and multiple statements stay unresolved or silent. Files with ALTER/DROP FUNCTION need lifecycle analysis and stay silent for this rule. Deliberately reading temporary relations may be intended.

sources.claim: SECURITY DEFINER functions need safe name resolution: pg_temp should follow trusted schemas, and protected relations should be qualified.
Taxonomy for the local API/configuration boundary, not execution or exploitability evidence.
